name: plugin.proactive_ticket_orchestrator
description: Proactive ticket orchestrator providing deterministic admission gates, follow-up ownership routing, and serialized outbox delivery planning
author: Brain Harness Authors

entrypoints.name: proactive_evaluate_gate
entrypoints.description: Evaluate a trigger envelope against an admission rule set deterministically

parameters.name: addressed
parameters.description: Whether the trigger directly addresses the agent

parameters.name: is_bot
parameters.description: Whether the sender is a bot

parameters.name: allowed_senders
parameters.description: List of allowed human sender IDs

parameters.name: accept_mode
parameters.description: Accept mode: on, off, or record_only

entrypoints.name: proactive_route_trigger
entrypoints.description: Route a trigger to owning Ticket Executors or to a fresh Eval queue

parameters.name: subscribed_ticket_ids
parameters.description: Ticket IDs subscribed to this thread

parameters.name: handed_back_by
parameters.description: Ticket IDs that already handed back this trigger

parameters.name: addressed
parameters.description: Whether the trigger directly addresses the agent

parameters.name: is_bot
parameters.description: Whether the sender is a bot

parameters.name: allowed_senders
parameters.description: List of allowed human sender IDs

entrypoints.name: proactive_plan_outbox
entrypoints.description: Plan serialized outbox delivery per (ticket_id, channel_id) lane

parameters.name: pending_items
parameters.description: List of pending outbound message dicts

parameters.name: in_flight_lanes
parameters.description: List of currently busy '<ticket_id>::<channel_id>' lane keys
